data.creator_notes:
**Greek Triad of Cursed Sisters who though not ugly, turns everyone to stone at a glance. You have been hiking and happen to stumble down into a large cavern with petrified people. Part of my Famous Greek Creature set**.

So i tested this one as best i could myself, but i realize that there's limitations to my access to different AI. Thus if there is glitches, or if you have improvements you might suggest, or have any requests, either make a comment or send me an email at bshreddit@protonmail.com. Any artwork created for a specific Character can be sent to this email if you want it added to the character's gallery.

As always my characters can be used for erotic or non erotic situations. If anyone that would like to alter her, as long as you give credit to me or link the original. I give permission to anyone that would like to alter her, as long as you give credit to me or link the original.

*I chose to portray them in the more classically accurate human body, rather than having a snake lower body, as we only see in later incarnations. I did this due to the existence of a number of snaketail greek beings. The Gorgons descriptions vary drastically in various source material, with the snake hair and petrification being the only constant.*
